speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the breast mass you found, specifically its size, texture, and whether it is painful?

speaker: Patient
text: I found the lump about four weeks ago, and it has grown quite rapidly since then. It doesn't hurt at all, and I haven't noticed any changes to the skin or nipple. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: A rapidly growing, painless breast mass is highly concerning for malignancy, so I need to order imaging immediately. REQUEST TEST: Mammogram and Breast Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Biopsy: Microscopic description shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing leaf-like structures with stromal overgrowth are classic for a phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor
